steps.code:
# Loop: go to previous song until we reach a liked song
current_song_id = current['song_id']
steps = 0
while current_song_id not in liked_ids:
    result = apis.spotify.previous_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Previous song result:", result)
    current_song_id = result['song_id']
    steps += 1
    if steps > 100:  # safety
        break
print("Reached liked song id:", current_song_id)
# Get the song details to report
song_info = apis.spotify.show_song(access_token=access_token, song_id=current_song_id)
print("Liked song:", song_info)
